# Grouped CP expressions for IEEE-9 converter degree-five terms

Numerical factors fitted with `ieee9_gfl_ode_degree5_cp.py` using `myenv`.
These expressions cover only the degree-five contributions to the listed six equations per converter.
They are CP expressions over five groups of state variables, not over 49 individual binary modes.

For each converter, with matrices `O, N, I, V, C, A` and weights `w`,

```text
d5 = O @ (w * (N.T @ x[network]) * (I.T @ x[line])
          * (V.T @ x[voltage_angle]) * (C.T @ x[current_angle])
          * (A.T @ x[output_angle]))
```

Equivalently, each output equation is the sum of eight products of five linear forms.
Columns 1 through 8 of each matrix belong to the corresponding CP terms.
State indices are zero-based indices in the reduced 49-state vector.
